translation:
It went up to the head, and from the crown turned back to the brain; on the right side there was none. I also learned that disease has left and right, light and heavy, distinguished by the amount of accumulation.

Twenty-seven: The various places were all clear, and I thought myself correct, but the bone of the jaw could never be cleared; they all rose from the left and right of the root of the neck, one wave following another in succession. There were those with qi threading through the shoulders and flanks causing pain, those with tinea breaking out at Danzhong causing itching, those with worms crawling in the back and spine, and those with sinews cramping in the hands and feet causing itching and pain.
